scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/prerender.ts --outDir .prerender && node .prerender/prerender.js
scripts.lint: eslint --flag unstable_native_nodejs_ts_config src/App.svelte "src/*.ts" tests playwright.config.ts eslint.config.ts && npm run format:check
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src/App.svelte src/app.css "src/*.ts" tests playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json .prettierrc.json docs README.md .github/workflows/quality.yml eslint.config.ts
